svg.title: V2 memory banking and persistent KV cache
svg.desc: Production V2 memory data movement, fixed 4Q:2KV and HEAD_DIM 16 or 64. AXI read DMA combines two accepted good 64-bit beats: the held first beat supplies stripe bytes 0 to 7; the live second beat supplies bytes 8 to 15. Each vector write is a full aligned 128-bit, 16-byte stripe and targets one destination per descriptor. Q uses one reusable 4096-byte scratchpad reloaded before each serial query head. Two physical KV groups each contain separate 4096-byte K and V stores; Q0 and Q1 select KV0, Q2 and Q3 select KV1. All five stores use sixteen byte-wide banks of 256 entries, with bank=a[3:0] and bank row=a shifted right by 4. A worked local-address example maps bytes 0x040 through 0x04F to banks 0 through 15 at bank row 4. Each bank has one synchronous read and one synchronous write port; memory read latency is one cycle. The bank primitive supports one read plus one write, but cache read/write overlap is not scheduled in the production path. K/V writes are ordered K then V for KV0, then KV1; read-group selection is separate from load-group selection. During foreground loading, Q is read in Q mode and paired K and V are read together at the same address in KV mode, from only the selected group. The loader emits aligned stripes into active row-major Q, K and V tile registers, each with 16 times HEAD_DIM elements. Invalid tail stripes have no memory read request and are emitted as zeros; attention masking separately excludes invalid keys. K stays row-major; K transpose is implemented in compute operand selection, not a transpose memory. One shared 16 by 16, 256-PE array executes all four heads serially. V2 prefetch is disabled. The allocated size is 4096 bytes per K/V store, while logical capacity is 64 tokens times HEAD_DIM: 1024 bytes for d16 or 4096 for d64. KV residency persists across healthy commands and ACK, subject to replacement, append, invalidation and common-reset lifecycle rules. External memory responder is simulation-only. These are logical RTL stores, not physically implemented SRAM macros or memory-inclusive PPA; no sustained throughput claim is made.
svg.text: V2 memory banking & persistent KV cache
Five banked stores · d16 / d64 · one shared serial compute engine
Arrows show supported phases; no concurrent broadcast.
Logical capacity per K/V store: 64 × d bytes
KV population: K then V; KV0 then KV1
K stays row-major; Kᵀ via operand selection
Aligned full stripes; no partial-byte DMA writes.
Q load first; then paired K + V reads.
Memory read: 1 cycle; loader aligns register writes.
Cache read/write overlap is not scheduled.
Invalid tail: no memory read; loader emits zeros.
DMA loads retire before the compute pass.

Highlighted cells show byte addresses (hex), not stored data.

svg.text: Logical RTL stores; physical SRAM macros and memory-inclusive PPA are not established. No sustained-throughput claim.
